notes.title: Good News & Bad News
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Core Romance Specialists![/h3][p]Due to some internal conflicts, our release on Steam will not be ready by August 28th. We know this is a big disappointment, but it's out of our hands. We are not sure when the Steam build will be ready.[/p][p][b]However, you WILL still be able to play the game on August 28th.[/b][/p][p]At 3:00 PM MST, we'll be opening our Itch.io page, where the game will be downloadable, playable, and fully accessible in its entirety. This page will only be accessible until the Steam release is complete, after which it will be archived for bug testing. [/p][p]I apologize greatly on behalf of me and my team - I know this is not the news you wanted to hear. We're still consistent with our release, though, so expect to see us on Itch THIS THURSDAY![/p][p][/p][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/6D9ZhZVDf6"]Discord[/url] or subscribe to our [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ApertureDatingSimulator"]YouTube[/url] to stay updated. Thank you all![/p][p][/p][p]Love,
Ashleyanna Rivers
APDS Developer[/p]
